dslRule:
<!id: NlsToolWarningReduction_RevertLineAction_PREFIX>
<!description: Replace usage of RevertLineAction.PREFIX with its literal value "RevertLineAction." to reduce NLS tool warnings, effectively inlining the constant.
Note: This rule only replaces the usage; the constant field declaration itself would need to be removed manually if unused.
>
<!severity: INFO>
org.eclipse.ui.internal.editors.quickdiff.RevertLineAction.PREFIX
=>
"RevertLineAction."
;;
summary: Inlines the string literal value of `RevertLineAction.PREFIX` into its usage.
